plainTranslation: Closeness pulls hard against restriction. One reaches for reassurance; the other withholds, criticizes, or goes distant, and it can feel like affection on ration. Failure mode: the Moon person keeps earning a love that never quite arrives and calls the deprivation depth. Loosen the grip and reassure freely - or be honest that the coldness is the problem, not a phase.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
